title: Biome formatter override for byte-identical check-all scripts
rationale: The fleet templates check-all.ts/check-ci-parity.ts must stay byte-identical (cmp-verified) but are not format-clean under the canonical biome config (template defect, reproduced in warren); disabling the formatter for exactly those two files keeps both invariants until the template is reformatted fleet-wide.

name: ci-parity-escape-hatches
description: CI-parity escape hatches live in scripts/ci-parity-config.json, never in the byte-identical script: aliases map reporter-variant scripts to their canonical gate (test:ci -> check:coverage), ciOnly allowlists artifact/summary steps (report:test-timing, report:quality-metrics). Doc references to files that only exist in the os-eco meta-repo (docs/check-all-standard.md) need a --known-missing flag on check:agents — gate-body flags are sanctioned, gate names are frozen.

content: scripts/coverage-budgets.json floors were stale (78/74) while observed All-files was 96.71/96.18. After adding tested code, run 'bun test --coverage', read the All files row, and raise floors to floor(observed) in the same commit; note the issue id in the _comment.

name: subprocess-cli-coverage
description: CLI command modules exercised only via Bun.spawn subprocesses never appear in Bun's in-process coverage report. When trellis-9a88 rewired client tests off the legacy runAudit (src/report/run.ts), the aggregate dropped below the 97% floor even though the CLI subprocess tests all passed. Fix: keep a direct in-process service test for transitional legacy code (src/report/run.test.ts) until the staged plan deletes it.

content: corpus/manifest.json declares entries, runtime/memory budgets (maxMedianMs/maxPeakRssMb), single-entry checks, and paired-refactor expectations (expectIncrease/Decrease/Unchanged + indexDelta bounds); scripts/validate-corpus.ts spawns a fresh bun child per run and reads /proc/self VmHWM for clean peak RSS; tests use the in-process fast path. Corpus fixtures live outside src//scripts includes so lint/tsc/jscpd skip them; the repo trellis.yaml excludes corpus/** from the dogfood self-audit.
